Complete the finite telemetry compiler in the supplied NetNomos core.
Work in `/workspace`; submit the complete `/workspace/submission/` directory.
The existing miner supplies ASTs, projection, evaluation, and a best-effort learner.
Extend that code into the exact pipeline defined in `PROTOCOL.md`.
Use Python 3.11.14; required CPU dependencies are supplied offline in `vendor/`.
Learn every eligible inclusion-minimal disjunction from typed window data.
Report canonical clauses with deterministic evidence and counterexamples.
Apply only the operator-approved clauses that were actually learned.
For each decoding query, find all next tokens with a complete extension.
Feasibility uses the joint theory and declared domains, including unseen data.
`submission/main.py` reads one JSON batch from stdin and writes one JSON result.
All required keys, orderings, empty cases, and resource limits are in the protocol.
You may modify or replace modules and add regular files within the submission.
Keep its total size at most 16 MiB and its total entries at most 512.
Run `python3 public_check.py submission` for the public examples.
The check runs the complete submitted package in a bounded child process.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
